newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures in firm holding pattern.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures in firm holding pattern.

text.p: The Australian wheat futures market remained in its established pattern on Wednesday with quiet trading on a firm tone.
May 1997 was the only contract to trade, rising by A$2.50 to A$170.00 a tonne on a single lot traded.
The Australian market continued to be supported by good export sales and by the Australian Wheat Board pool price, Kerrin Gleeson of Elders Risk Management Pty Ltd said.
Chicago's overnight rise could have a slight impact on Australian values, he said. SFE settlement prices were mixed, with the nearby March 1997 contract steady on A$170.50.
